test_doc_integration: test runnable Python code blocks embedded in markdown documentation files
create_doc_integration_test: create a DocIntegrationTest subclass with a doc_path pointing to a markdown file containing runnable code blocks
build_runnable_blocks: build a list of RunnableBlock objects from markdown text containing fenced Python code blocks marked as runnable
execute_code_block: execute a Python code block from documentation in an isolated namespace and raise AssertionError on failure
resolve_decorator: resolve a decorator from a dotted import path like 'transformers.testing_utils.slow'
